final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and its extra lines. Filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL entries (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC with "Z" suffix. Extracted message after service name, uppercased level, and last traceback line or null. Summed repeat counts from repeated message lines. Aggregated counts by service. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
